people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Mary
people.line: Mother of Jesus; wife of Joseph.

people.name: Simeon
people.line: Righteous and devout man who blessed Jesus in the temple.

translations.web: and Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is set for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.
